verdict.rationale: Brex documents a Transactions API for viewing transactions, accounts, and statements, and an Expenses API with receipt upload and automatic matching. Access uses dashboard-generated user tokens with selectable data-access scopes, and Postman collections cover all Brex APIs. Missing for 10: an evidenced OAuth authorization flow (only dashboard-created scoped tokens are documented), explicit receipt retrieval/download (only upload is shown), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
